name: delivery
description: A project-agnostic delivery pipeline for Claude Code: workflows that take a GitHub issue from implementation through independent review, fix and re-review, and that turn a topic into a filed epic with sub-issues. Exists because Claude Code cannot invoke an agent directly — dispatch is only ever a model reading a description and choosing — so a pipeline written as a convention is a request, while a workflow is a command whose sequence is code. Ships seven agents and eight skills; every dispatched prompt reads the project's own CLAUDE.md for its hard rules rather than hardcoding any.
